high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a news article from Bloomberg Business, as indicated by the logo and the "Bloomberg.com" link at the bottom. The headline reads: "GameStop raises $2.14 billion on the back of Roaring Kitty-led rally." The photo shows the exterior of a GameStop store. The storefront has a large sign with the GameStop logo prominently displayed in red and white letters. Below the main sign, there is a smaller sign that says "THINK GEEK" in green and white letters. The store's glass doors are partially open, allowing a glimpse inside where various posters and displays are visible
